what: every assert site of the arm (contracts/account-evm-k256.compact, contracts/modules/EvmK256.compact, contracts/modules/K256Core.compact, contracts/modules/EvmIdentity.compact, contracts/modules/Eip712V1.compact) and of the shared modules it reaches (contracts/modules/WalletArmRendering.compact, contracts/modules/WalletArmDescriptors.compact, contracts/modules/Ed25519Core.compact), by its enclosing circuit; a site counts when its circuit is reachable by the call graph from one of the arm's exported circuits (its own and the pure circuits it re-exports); each reached site with the cases of the run of record that refuse it at the constraint level as their own expected refusal (the circuit under test reaches no other site with that message, or that site's deletion mutant alone lets the case's forgery through), after the honest call proved through the same patched copy; otherwise why not

unreachedSites.message: display: digits do not match the value
descriptor: not an Ed25519 device tag
ed25519: the key is the identity
